description_full: Open House Group Co., Ltd. operates in the real estate businesses. It provides real estate sales and purchase agency/brokerage services. The company also sells newly built detached houses; and develops condominiums. In addition, it engages in the real estate investment and finance businesses; and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Open House Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Open House Group Co., Ltd. in January 2022. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

financial_summary: OPEN HSE GROUP CO LTD is a mid-cap real estate business with a $5.0B market cap.
The top line has compounded at +5% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.

Returns on capital run at 17% against a 8% cost of capital, a 9-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, and 19% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The business throws off $171M in free cash flow, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 145.7× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss.

Management returns a meaningful 5.8% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 36% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
